thread:
Jin (oncall): FYI seeing a small egress TLS retry spike from ap-southeast around 06:12 UTC. looks similar to earlier cross-region tls bursts. starting a quick triage here.
Maya (SRE): saw it on the graphs too. retry rate up ~15%, spike lasted ~10m.
Sam (neteng): checking routing and POP telemetry now. any recent deploys?
Dev Deploy Bot: no deploys in the last 3 hours for affected services.
Olivia (eng-runtime): grabbing runtime logs. early grep shows SNI negotiation failures and occasional unsupported_extension errors. sample: `tls: handshake failed: unsupported_extension (SNI mismatch)`
Priya (product): is this the same pattern from the last postmortem? we flagged recurring cross-region tls issues there.
Maya (SRE): looks related but not identical — last time it correlated with cert rotation lag. this one shows routing anomalies to a particular edge.
Sam (neteng): initial check: ap-southeast-pop-03 observed intermittent BGP export anomalies during the window. might be routing traffic via stale edge that lacks recent cert bindings.
Jin (oncall): propose immediate soft-splay away from ap-southeast-pop-03 to reduce customer impact. Sam, can you handle?
Sam (neteng): executing soft-splay now.
Dev Deploy Bot: route-splay executed by Sam at 06:28 UTC.
Maya (SRE): after the splay, retries dropped ~60% within 6 minutes. good short-term signal.
Olivia (eng-runtime): I'll prepare a fallback config behind a feature flag so runtime can avoid hard failures on TLS handshake errors and fall back to regional endpoints. target draft by EOD.
Priya (product): if we enable regional fallback, we should prepare a short comms note about potential latency change for affected customers.
Jin (oncall): assigning actions: Sam -> routing deep-dive and permanent egress failover rule (ETA 7d); Maya -> telemetry correlation and alert tuning (ETA 3h); Olivia -> fallback config PR & canary (ETA EOD); Priya -> comms playbook check (ETA 24h); Jin -> postmortem draft and recurrence analysis (ETA 48h).
Maya (SRE): adding this to weekly incident trends as a recurrence candidate (3 events in last 45 days).
Sam (neteng): working with infra to fix BGP export flakiness and add faster failover.
Olivia (eng-runtime): will tag requests using fallback so we can measure p99 delta.
Jin (oncall): closing triage for now. will reopen thread if retries spike again. :thumbsup:
